result.stdout:
Usage: hyperdu [path] [options]

Options:
  -h, --help         Show this help text
  -v, --version      Show version information
  -t, --threads <N>  Set the number of concurrent worker threads (default: CPU 
logical cores)
  -e, --exclude <path> Add a path to the exclusion list (can be specified 
multiple times. default: None)
  --skip-hidden       Skip hidden and system files/folders
